scope: Own native logic, own ARM instructions with six stock mocks, static official-image inspection. Native queue/PWM/IRQs not executed.

results.checks: Seven native ASan/UBSan suites, two analyzer checks. Audio cadence bounds/monotonicity/wrap/disable, no-link silence, context gates, stock busy priority, bounded heap checks.
Eight ARM/Thumb scenarios; six stock mocks; registers, SP, PRIMASK and write-boundary guards. Cadence, stale link, exit, busy queue and malformed/depleted heap.
Nine static cases: hash/vectors/bounds/22 patches/independent BL decode, original-image requirement, native short-tone queue calls unchanged.
Framing, CRC, signed RSSI, bounded memory, connect/export/stale/disconnect behavior using synthetic DOM and serial.

previous_user_evidence.reported: User reports successful installation. User demonstrated loader UART 0x43 and exit back to normal operation. No independent recovery test with broken application.

not_tested: Native audio queue and allocator under real IRQ timing
Independent recovery after application startup failure
Flight safety and complete channel/failsafe behavior
